title: Jack and the Map of Where the Rain Went
synopsis: The friends remember the rain by making a small sloping-tray experiment at home, checking Jack's rain gauge, and drawing a map of the water's several routes.
continuity_state: Before: The rain gauge still holds its reading at the third mark; the street sweeper cleaned the road edge, the vacuum truck cleaned the storm inlet, and the farm-road culvert and shoulder have been checked and restored. The little walking bridge and park remain intact. After: Jack records the earlier rain-gauge level permanently in his blue notebook and empties the gauge with Aunt Jo so it can catch a future rain. Jack adds a hand-drawn rain-route page showing soil, curb, drain, and farm-road culvert. The municipal trucks depart with their collected material, and all places return to their ordinary routines. Season Six resolves without outstanding drainage trouble.
